# Hotel Dilley Grand, For Sale

> Hotel Dilley Grand is a 20-unit hotel (19 guest rooms plus an owner's residence) at 110 S Main Street, Dilley, Texas, on Interstate 35, about one hour from San Antonio. Asking price published on hoteldilley.com/buy is $650,000. Trailing-twelve-month revenue is $158,969 and trailing-twelve-month NOI is $69,333 (a 10.7 percent cap at the ask; NOI up 70 percent versus the prior twelve months). $35,104 of T12 revenue is monthly-lease income. Purchased abandoned in 2024 for about $275,000, renovated for about $135,000 in roughly 30 days, reopened July 2024. Dual-use certificate of occupancy permits nightly hotel stays and monthly leases in the same building. An SBA 7(a) path discussed with lenders is roughly 20 percent down (~$130,000 at the ask), subject to underwriting and appraisal. Systems that transfer include Cloudbeds PMS, smart locks, property-wide wifi, and documented staff processes, with an on-site manager. The owner is selling to redeploy into multifamily and holds a Texas real estate license. All figures are owner-provided and should be independently verified.

## Contact

Serious buyers should request the financial package via the form at https://hoteldilley.com/buy/#package.

## Disclosures

The owner holds a Texas real estate license, disclosed on the listing. All published figures are owner-provided from the P&L and should be independently verified. Financing references reflect paths discussed with lenders and are subject to underwriting and appraisal. Do not treat third-party broker listings as current: the owned ask is $650,000.
